CG: Cortech Heavy Duty PVC Corner Guards
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-cg-corner-guards
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/facility-maintenance/corner-guards/
Spec sheet: CG
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Heavy Duty PVC Corner Guards – CG
Current H1: Cortech Corner Guards - CG
Subtitle: 48” Wall Corner Guards in 1” to 4” Widths, Bullnose, Wood Grain, and Diamond Tread, with Adhesive or Screw Mounting
Current subtitle: None
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Heavy Duty PVC Corner Guards protect drywall, plaster, and concrete wall corners from chips, dings, and damage in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities, kitchens, hallways, storage areas, and parking garages, anywhere carts, forklifts, or dollies are used.
The 48” guards are made of PVC in the USA and come in 1” to 4” widths, a 2½” bullnose for rounded or obtuse corners, a 1½” wood grain style, and 3” and 4” diamond tread. Each one mounts with factory installed adhesive tape or with tamper-resistant screws.
Material: Heavy duty PVC with high impact resistance; virtually unbreakable
Length: 48” (8’ lengths available on request)
Widths: 1”, 2”, 3”, or 4” standard; 2½” bullnose; 1½” wood grain; 3” or 4” diamond tread
Edges: Beveled edge for a finished look
Bullnose: Bullnose corner guards fit rounded or obtuse corners
Mounting: Factory installed adhesive tape, or tamper-resistant screws (hardware included)
Indoor or Outdoor Use: Weather resistant for interior or exterior use
Flammability: Flame retardant, except clear corner guards and corner guards with adhesive mounting
Colors: Almond, Black, Bronze, Clear, Eggshell, Gray, Silver, White, or Yellow; wood grain in Beige, Blue, or White; diamond tread in Silver or Yellow. Clear is available with screw mounting only
Care: Easy to clean with a soap and water solution
Packaging: Price is per piece. Packed 20 per case; must buy in full cases
Warranty: 10-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
1”×1”×48”: Almond, Black, Bronze, Eggshell, Gray, Silver, White, or Yellow, adhesive or screw mount; Clear, screw mount (for example CGA1X1X48A, CGA1X1X48FR)
2”×2”×48”: Same colors and mounting as the 1” (for example CGA2X2X48A, CGA2X2X48FR)
3”×3”×48”: Same colors and mounting as the 1” (for example CGA3X3X48A, CGA3X3X48FR)
4”×4”×48”: Same colors and mounting as the 1” (for example CGA4X4X48A, CGA4X4X48FR)
2½”×2½”×48” Bullnose: Same colors and mounting as the 1” (for example CGABNA, CGABNFR)
1½”×1½”×48” Wood Grain: CGTBG - Beige Grain, CGTBL - Blue Grain, CGTWH - White Grain
3”×3”×48” Diamond Tread: CGDS3x3x48FR - Silver, CGDY3x3x48FR - Yellow, screw mount
4”×4”×48” Diamond Tread: CGDS4x4x48FR - Silver, CGDY4x4x48FR - Yellow, screw mount
Part Numbers: CG + color code (A Almond, B Black, C Clear, E Eggshell, G Gray, H Bronze, S Silver, W White, Y Yellow) + size + A for adhesive mount or FR for screw mount
Installation and Options
Adhesive Mount: Factory installed adhesive tape
Screw Mount: Tamper-resistant screws; hardware included
[H2] Applications
Corner guards suit busy areas where wall corners take hits from carts, beds, and equipment.
Typical applications include:
Hallways, dayrooms, and kitchens in correctional facilities and jails
Hallways and common areas in behavioral healthcare facilities and hospitals
Storage areas, loading areas, and parking garages
Explore Anchortex's Hardware for Behavioral Health Care Facilities and Prison & Detention Hardware & Equipment collections for more security hardware.
[H2] About Cortech Facilities Maintenance
Cortech facilities maintenance products are molded to stand up to hard daily use in correctional facilities, behavioral healthcare facilities, and other high-abuse settings.
Cortech facilities maintenance includes:
Trash Receptacles: Cobra Cans in 20 to 55 gallon sizes, in flame retardant or food grade and general use material, and Cobra Mini Cans in 10 and 14 quart sizes
Carts: Kangaroo Carts and lids for laundry, trash, and material handling
Secure Waste Bins: The lockable SafeBin with a 35-gallon inner container
Wall Protection: Tiger Plates security wall plates and corner guards
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (54 characters): Cortech Heavy Duty PVC Corner Guards - CG at Anchortex
Meta description (151 characters): Shop Cortech heavy duty PVC corner guards, 48” wall corner protection in 1” to 4” widths, bullnose, and diamond tread, with adhesive or screw mounting.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Facilities Maintenance" is the same section as on the Cobra Can, Mini Can, Kangaroo Cart, and SafeBin pages. I added a "Wall Protection" line for Tiger Plates and corner guards. Would you like it added to those pages too?
H1: Cortech calls them Corner Guards ("Heavy Use Corner/Wall Guards" on the spec sheet). I added "Heavy Duty PVC."
Variants: I kept all 92 variants as they are (size, color, and mounting in one option). Two names have a double space before the color (CGABNFR, Bullnose Almond, and CGG3X3X48FR, 3x3x48 Gray). Would you like those two fixed?
Colors: your current page says "Available in 5 colors." Your variants have nine standard colors plus the wood grain and diamond tread colors, so I listed those. The Cortech spec sheet says 11 standard colors but does not match your list exactly.
Weight: the Cortech spec sheet says the weight "varies by size." Your variants are set to 2, 3, or 4 lbs, and guards of the same size have different weights (for example, the 1”×1” guards are set to 2, 3, and 4 lbs). I did not change them.
Fasteners: the spec sheet features say tamper resistant screws, but the assembly line says regular Phillips head. I used tamper-resistant screws, as on your current page.
Packaging: "Price is per piece. Packed 20 per case; must buy in full cases" comes from your current page. The Cortech spec sheet does not mention cases.
Collection links: Corner Guards are only in your Cortech collection. I linked your Hardware for Behavioral Health Care Facilities and Prison & Detention Hardware & Equipment collections. Would you like Corner Guards added to those collections?
I left out the Cortech "About" text from your current page.
Product images: the page has three images. The Cortech product page has a photo of almost every variant. Would you like me to add a few, for example one of each size?
